users.deactivateText: The user will be signed out and will not be able to sign in or vote until you activate the account again.
users.emptyText: Try a different search or filter.
users.managerRoleHint: Club managers are assigned from the club's management screen, so the role cannot be changed here.
users.removeText: The account will be removed and can no longer sign in. Votes that were already cast stay counted.
users.search: Search by name, email, phone or student ID
users.subtitle: Create, edit and manage accounts.

faculties.activeHint: Inactive faculties are hidden from the registration form.
faculties.deleteText: Only faculties without any users can be deleted. Deactivate it instead if students are assigned to it.
faculties.subtitle: The faculties students choose from when they register.
faculties.title: Faculties

clubs.activeHint: Inactive clubs cannot be subscribed to or used in new elections.
clubs.canCreateHint: The manager can create and publish elections for this club.
clubs.canDelegateHint: The manager can vote for students who cannot vote online. Also requires the system-wide switch and the election option.
clubs.name: Club name
clubs.revokeText: {{name}} will no longer be a manager of {{club}}.
clubs.revoked: The manager has been removed from this club.
clubs.subtitle: Manage clubs and who runs them.
clubs.title: Clubs

events.emptyText: Create the first election to get started.
events.subtitle: University and club elections.
events.title: Events

competitions.cancelText: The competition will be cancelled and removed from students' lists. This cannot be undone.
competitions.closeText: Voting ends immediately and no more votes are accepted. This cannot be undone.
competitions.deleteText: This draft will be permanently deleted.
competitions.emptyText: Create a competition between two to four clubs.
competitions.publishText: Students will be able to see this competition and vote during its schedule.
competitions.subtitle: Competitions where students vote for their favourite club.
competitions.title: Club competitions

settings.delegatedText: Delegated voting lets an authorised club manager cast a vote on behalf of a student who cannot vote online. It is off by default. It only works when this switch is on, the election allows it, and the manager has been granted permission.
settings.disableText: Club managers will no longer be able to cast delegated votes anywhere.
settings.enableText: Club managers who have been granted permission will be able to cast votes on behalf of students in elections that allow it.
settings.subtitle: Platform-wide options.
settings.title: System settings
settings.warningText: A delegated vote skips the student's own SMS verification, so every one is written to the audit log. Turn this on only if your university's election rules allow it.

actions.competition.close_and_publish_results: Closed a competition and published its results
actions.event.close_and_publish_results: Closed an event and published its results

audit.emptyText: Administrative actions will be listed here.
audit.privacyNote: Passwords, codes and the options chosen by voters are never recorded here.
audit.subtitle: A tamper-evident record of administrative actions.
audit.title: Audit log
audit.verifyBroken: The chain is broken at entry {{id}}. The log may have been altered. Investigate before relying on it.
audit.verifyOk: All {{n}} entries are intact and correctly chained.
